text:
Olivia: Quick UX review request — spent time in the routing policies editor simulator. Noticed a few things that block usability: priority ordering affordance, preview ambiguous state when rules are partially matched, and validation copy is terse/confusing. Mock screenshots attached (not included). Can we do quick triage? Sam: +1. High priority if this affects canary testing. Also want keyboard nav to be solid for accessibility and power users. Alex: Can you list specific examples? I tried the simulator; it seems okay but maybe I'm missing edge cases. Olivia: Specifics: 1) Drag handle is small and not discoverable; users tried clicking the whole row expecting reorder. 2) When preview shows "no match" for a rule that's actually shadowed by a higher-priority rule, the badge just says "no match" — misleading. 3) Validation errors like "condition invalid" — no hint on which field or what's wrong. Maya: For the drag: we can make the whole left 24px area a drag target and add a grip icon + cursor: grab. Also we should support keyboard reorder (focus rule -> meta+arrow). Maya: Proposed ARIA snippet: ```html
Rule A
``` Jordan: Accessibility nits: contrast for the "no match" chip is 2.8:1 on our palette — fails AA. Suggest using #005f99 or adding an outline. Also need screenreader-friendly duplication: the preview should say "Preview: rule not evaluated due to higher priority" not just visual chip. Olivia: Love that phrasing. Also for validation copy: propose: "Condition pattern invalid — expected operator (equals, contains, regex) or value. Click for more." make the "Click for more" a help tooltip. Sam: UX ask: add a small "why" link on the preview that opens a side panel showing evaluation steps (which rule matched first etc.). Useful for debugging. Alex: Backend note — we can expose evaluation trace in the simulator API as an array of steps. Will design payload: [ruleId, matched, reason] (more structured in prod). ETA: next week. Maya: For keyboard reorder we can implement aria-live announcements like "Moved rule to position 2 of 5". Also ensure focus remains on the moved item. Olivia: Great. Action items: Maya - implement keyboard + drag affordance and ARIA; Jordan - provide exact color tokens and SR copy; Alex - add evaluation trace endpoint; Sam - add small "why" UI in panel; Olivia - update copy and microcopy. Can we sync tomorrow 10am? :calendar: Sam: 10am works. I'll add to calendar and invite eng/design.
